capability.title: Render Video — UGC Vertical
capability.summary: Bound by e-commerce and any 9:16 slot. Hard cuts, oversized captions in the safe area, product held high in frame, offer end-card. A different FILM, not a different pipeline.

template.safe_area_note: Captions sit at 72% height: above the platform UI on TikTok and Reels, below the product. Anything lower is covered by the caption tray on a real device.
